noise_definition: baseline_noise_pct is pstdev/median*100 over 15 timed calls after 3 untimed warmup calls, with gc disabled during sampling. Commands were pinned to one CPU with taskset -c 0.
excluded: datalad/support/path.py get_parent_paths and _get_parent_paths_check: merged dexhunter perf PR https://github.com/datalad/datalad/pull/7979
AnnexRepo._save_add / _maybe_batched_add / _call_annex batch-add path: open upstream semver-performance PR https://github.com/datalad/datalad/pull/6977

targets.native_test_cmd: python3 -m pytest -q datalad/support/tests/test_fileinfo.py -k "get_content_info or test_compare_content_info or test_info_path_inside_submodule"
targets.workload: 8000 synthetic git ls-files --stage lines (type/sha present, so no stat) parsed into absolute pathlib paths
targets.why_hot: On a profile of GitRepo.get_content_info and diffstatus over 8000 committed files, this helper was almost all of the Python time. Each line builds a PurePosixPath and joins it onto the repo Path, which reparses and hashes the path.

targets.workload: 548790-byte NUL-separated ls-files -z style stream, fed in 4096-byte chunks to LineSplitter(separator=None), the mode GitRepo.call_git uses
targets.why_hot: separator=None calls splitlines twice on the accumulated buffer. git -z output has no newlines, so every chunk is one unterminated line and the whole buffer is rescanned. The same stream with separator='\0' was about 0.3 ms.

targets.workload: 8000 repo-relative paths filtered by 20 directory prefixes with include_within_path=True (get_submodules_ path constraint)
targets.why_hot: Called from GitRepo.get_submodules_ to constrain submodule paths. Every path is turned into a PurePosixPath and sorted as a tuple of parts before the merge walk.

targets.workload: 20000 filenames mixing .tar.gz, .nii.gz, and .txt, the git-annex splitShortExtensions rule used by addurls
targets.why_hot: addurls get_file_parts and get_url_parts call split_ext per row. The body splits, reverses, and dropwhile-filters the parts instead of scanning once from the right.

targets.workload: 8000 non-progress git-annex find --json records (success, key, bytesize, file) with no Total bar
targets.why_hot: AnnexJsonProtocol.pipe_data_received calls this for every JSON record. A cProfile of 4000 find records spent more time here than in json.loads: each record hashes a frozenset progress id and parses the annex key even when the record is not a byte-progress event and total_nbytes is unset. Does not overlap open PR 6977, which changes annex add --batch.

targets.workload: 4000-key git config -z --list --show-origin dump (origin record plus key=value, repeated)
targets.why_hot: Every GitRepo and .gitmodules read goes through this parser. Each NUL record is regex-matched in _gitcfg_rec_to_keyvalue, and file: origins are wrapped in Path objects.
